item.title: Azalea v0.4.0 - 2025-10-15
item.description:
Closed Playtesting Begins. First wave of community playtesters join the Azalea servers. Major performance improvements and initial feedback collection.
### Added - Discord community server launched - BetaHub feedback integration - Initial spawn point balancing
### Changed - Server performance optimization - Loot distribution system - Terrain collision accuracy
### Fixed - Various terrain clipping issues - Building placement bugs - Water shader artifacts

item.title: Azalea v0.3.0 - 2025-09-20
item.description:
Two massive POIs added to the map - the dangerous volcanic crater zone and the abandoned military installation.
### Added - Volcanic Crater POI with unique loot - Military Base complex - Underground bunker system - New weapon spawns
### Changed - Forest density and variation - Road network expansion - Lighting across the map
### Fixed - Pathfinding issues in urban areas - Skybox artifacts at sunset

item.title: Azalea v0.2.0 - 2025-08-10
item.description:
Expanded coastline with fishing villages, harbors, and beachside settlements.
### Added - 3 fishing villages - Harbor district - Lighthouse POI - Beach camping spots
### Changed - Ocean shader quality - Coastal terrain blending - Boat spawn locations
### Fixed - Water penetration in buildings - Coastal erosion visual bugs

item.title: Azalea v0.1.0 - 2025-07-01
item.description:
Initial Alpha Release. First playable version of Azalea released on Steam Workshop. Core terrain, basic POIs, and survival mechanics implemented.
### Added - 16km² island terrain - 10 major POIs - Basic loot economy - Steam Workshop integration
